jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Patient Care Coordinator ensures a positive patient experience by managing registration, appointment scheduling, and communication between patients and healthcare providers. They handle patient check-in, verify insurance, assist with billing, and maintain confidentiality of sensitive information. The role involves providing excellent customer service, supporting administrative tasks, and fostering effective patient-provider relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Greet and register patients, collecting accurate personal and insurance details.
Schedule and confirm appointments, coordinating with providers.
Answer calls professionally and direct inquiries appropriately.
Verify insurance coverage, assist with billing questions, and process payments.
Maintain organized patient records in compliance with healthcare regulations.
Complete pre-visit planning to ensure patient reminders and insurance verification.

Qualifications & Skills

High school diploma or equivalent; healthcare administration degree preferred.
Proficiency with electronic health records, scheduling, and billing systems.
Strong verbal and written communication, including telephone etiquette.
Knowledge of medical insurance processes and patient billing.
Experience in healthcare registration or front desk operations is advantageous.

Additional Information

This role does not involve supervisory duties and requires physical activities such as standing, reaching, and lifting up to 25 pounds. The position offers benefits like health, dental, vision insurance, life insurance, disability options, a 401(k) plan, PTO, and a salary range of $20-$24 per hour.
